newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Socialist Rexhep Mejdani elected Albania president.
newsitem.headline: Socialist Rexhep Mejdani elected Albania president.

text.p: Albania's parliament elected Socialist Party secretary-general Rexhep Mejdani as president on Thursday to replace Sali Berisha, who resigned a day earlier after five years in power.
Deputies elected Mejdani by 110 votes to three, with two abstentions and seven invalid ballots.
Mejdani, 52, joined the Socialist Party only last year after an academic career as a professor of physics.
Several Albanian newspapers on Thursday published pictures of him standing smiling with the U.S. ambassador at Wednesday's opening of parliament.

Berisha resigned on Wednesday to take up a seat as an opposition deputy for his Democratic Party, which suffered a resounding defeat in elections on June 29 after months of armed unrest sparked by the collapse of pyramid investment schemes.
